summary: Tested Account-Centric Sharing Model refactoring. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Account selector dropdown with owned accounts, Settings tab with Account Sharing component, New Post dialog working.

get_my_accounts_api.details: GET /api/account-sharing/my-accounts returns accessible accounts (owned + shared). Response includes account_id, handle, platform, _access_type (owned/shared), _role.

share_account_api.details: POST /api/account-sharing/share?account_id=X validates email and role, rejects invalid users/accounts with proper error codes (404, 403).

get_collaborators_api.details: GET /api/account-sharing/collaborators/{account_id} returns collaborators list with membership details, is_owner flag, and account info.

create_share_links_api.details: POST /api/account-sharing/links creates share links with name, password, expiry, permissions. Returns share_id and share_url.

get_share_links_api.details: GET /api/account-sharing/links/{account_id} returns active share links with share_id, share_url, name, permissions, has_password, expires_at, access_count.

revoke_share_link_api.details: DELETE /api/account-sharing/links/{share_id} revokes links, returns 404 for invalid IDs.

stats_filter_by_account.details: GET /api/demand-studio/social/stats?account_id=X correctly filters statistics by account.

posts_filter_by_account.details: GET /api/demand-studio/social/posts?account_id=X correctly filters posts by social_account_id.

insights_filter_by_account.details: GET /api/demand-studio/social/insights?account_id=X correctly filters insights by account.

calendar_filter_by_account.details: GET /api/demand-studio/social/calendar?account_id=X correctly filters calendar posts by account.

ideas_filter_by_account.details: GET /api/demand-studio/social/ideas?account_id=X correctly filters ideas by account.

account_selector_dropdown_ui.details: Account selector in Social Media header shows 'All my accounts' option plus 3 owned accounts: @creative_agency_demo (Instagram), @creative_agency_tiktok (TikTok), @creative-agency-demo (LinkedIn).

account_sharing_component_ui.details: AccountSharing.js component renders in Settings tab with account selector, collaborators list section, and share links management.

new_post_dialog_ui.details: New Post button opens dialog with Account dropdown showing available accounts, Format, Status, Campaign, Pillar selectors and content fields.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Account-centric sharing model is fully functional. Key endpoints: /api/account-sharing/my-accounts (returns owned + shared accounts), /api/account-sharing/share (share account with user), /api/account-sharing/collaborators/{account_id} (list collaborators), /api/account-sharing/links (CRUD for share links). All demand_studio social endpoints (stats, posts, insights, calendar, ideas) support account_id query parameter for filtering. Test user demo.agency@kora.com has 3 owned accounts: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn. The AccountSharing.js component is visible in Settings tab with account selector and sharing controls.
